title: nigritella fragrans var. megastachya
intro: Nigritella fragrans var. megastachya, commonly known as the Alpine Nigritella, is a species of orchid native to the alpine meadows of Europe. This plant has been found to possess several health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Nigritella fragrans var. megastachya include wound healing, anti-inflammatory effects, and protection against oxidative stress. Bioactive constituents present in this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which may contribute to its medicinal properties.
